title: Operator enablement playbook and release orchestration for private RBAC + audit + KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, operator-facing enablement playbook and release orchestration plan for Private/VPC feature set: RBAC (role sync + least-privilege templates), audit logging (centralized ELK/S3 sinks), and KMS integrations (BYOK/HSM patterns). The deliverable should include: release notes copy, staged rollout waves, test and rollback procedures, operator runbooks, onboarding checklist for customer operators, and cross-team communication/training schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published to Confluence with versioned artifact link and owner assigned
Release notes draft reviewed and signed off by legal and security
Operator runbook includes: preflight checklist, smoke tests, rollback steps, and escalation matrix
Training session scheduled and recorded; at least 3 operator teams invited and RSVP tracked
All engineering dependencies (ENG-4721, ENG-5983) have clear integration test signoffs and runbook hooks
rollout_waves: Wave 1: Internal operator pilot (2 customers simulated, duration 1 week) - enable RBAC-only with audit logging to staging sink
Wave 2: Early access customers (5 customers) - enable RBAC + audit + KMS in VPC regions us-west-2 and eu-west-1
Wave 3: Broader GA ramp with feature flag and telemetry gating - progressive rollout across accounts over 4 weeks
stakeholders: Engineering: Priya Shah (Runtime Lead), Omar Lin (Security Eng)
notes: Key trade-off: initial RBAC templates will favor simplicity (coarse roles) to reduce support load; plan to iterate to least-privilege in 2 sprint cycles.
KMS approach: support AWS KMS BYOK and HSM-backed keys for on-prem customers; note additional QAs for hardware key rotation.
Audit sinks: staging will write to isolated S3 bucket + temp ELK index for QA; production requires encryption-at-rest and 90-day retention policy as per compliance request.

Scheduling GA gating experiment to monitor error-rate and permission-deny spikes before widening rollout.
